AI Video Editor Easy 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Launches AI-powered video editing for MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB.
- Simple, natural-language workflow: upload, describe edits, and export video in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic backend setup with temporary free credits; handles authentication and session creation.
- Common edit actions include trimming pauses, adding transitions, and exporting 1080p MP4.
- Exposes status, credits, and export/download via clear chat commands.
- Cloud GPU rendering with step-by-step API routing; updated user on progress or errors.
